name: single-lookup
description: Find one receipt code hidden in 12 memos. Seed 20260905.
prompt: The docs directory holds 12 memos (n-01.txt through n-12.txt). Exactly one memo holds the issued receipt code on a line of the exact form Receipt code: QC-NNNN. The others say pending review and must be ignored. Use only the active tools for filesystem access. Finish with exactly one line with the exact form EVAL_RESULT {"file":F,"code":C} where F is the file's name (for example n-04.txt) and C is the code. Any other final line format is a failure.
